in_hebrew.name: Higginson
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Higginson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English 'hig' meaning 'high' and 'gysn' meaning 'son'. This name was given to a son born to a family of high social standing or a noble heritage.
